messages.subject: the mittens are too small!
messages.text:
Hello, 

I received my milkweed mittens (size small) but they are too small! Can I return them for a pair of medium mittens? 

Please advise as to how I do this. 

Many thanks, 

Leslie Stewart

huskystewart@gmail.com

messages.subject: mittens are too small!
messages.text:
Hello, The size-small milkweed mittens I received are too small! May I return them and exchange them for a pair of size medium?
 

 Please advise me how to proceed. 
 

 Order #: L- 45117
 

 Thank you, 
 

 Leslie Stewart
 huskystewart@gmail.com

messages.subject: Re: mittens are too small!
messages.text:
Hello Leslie,
 

 No problem regarding a return!
 

 We just want to know if you had the chance to consult our size guide before ordering: https://lasclay.com/pages/sizing-chart-guide-tailles.
 

 This allows us to better advise you.
 

 Warmly,
 

 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay

messages.text:
Hello, 
 I did consult the size guide and I checked a few times! Against my better judgment, I guess, I chose the small. My fingers are touching the top of the mitten and it doesn’t feel good. 
 Could I exchange for medium?
 Now, I have just gone on holiday and won’t be back until March 7. Can I send them back at that time?
 

 Many thanks, 
 Leslie Stewart
